text:
Alicia (product): Heads up — Customer ACME asked for per-tenant eval-triggered alerts plus an automatic quantization fallback policy. They care about noisy alerts and potential quality regressions. Need to define pilot gating + launch criteria. TL;DR: target false positives < 3% and regression SLO < 1%.

Mike (eng): Can we reuse the eval-sentry infra for tenant-scoped alerts? @Tara any obvious limits there?

Tara (eng-ml): We can reuse eval-sentry but it needs tenant-scoped thresholds and sampling rules. Proposal: 1) offline calibration jobs to set per-tenant baselines, 2) a canary rollout to ~5 customers, 3) opt-in beta flag. Also recommend multi-signal checks (not just regression_rate).

Sam (product-ops): Agree on pilot shape. Launch criteria we should require: docs + playbook, rollback plan, 2 production pilots with different workloads, automated alert dedupe, and cost cap per-tenant. Customer opt-out must be supported.

Alicia (product): I'll draft acceptance criteria. Can someone sketch a minimal policy DSL so we can prototype? Example: `if eval.regression_rate > 0.01 and delta_ppl > 2 then alert(customer)` — simple but expressive enough for POC.

Tara (eng-ml): Prefer multi-signal example (pseudo):
```
policy {
  when tenant_samples >= 5000 {
    signals: [regression_rate, topk_label_change, token_drift]
    trigger if (regression_rate > 0.01 and token_drift > 0.02) or (topk_label_change > 0.03)
    mute window: 1h
  }
}
```
Also quant fallback rule idea: `if latency_increase_pct > 30% and cost_per_token > threshold then fallback -> quantized:v2`

Mike (eng): For rollout we need: per-route and per-model metrics surfaced in Console, tenant mute + snooze controls, and an API to acknowledge alerts. Who owns UI pieces? @Sam?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot created ticket INF-4721 for canary infra (resources + tenant isolation). ETA ~4 days.

Sam (product-ops): I'll take the UI ownership for mute/ack flows. I'll also draft pilot comms. ACME wants an on-call contact and the ability to opt-out entirely.

Alicia (product): Action items: @Mike prototype the DSL + alert API, @Tara run calibration on 3 customer workloads (small/med/large), @Sam draft pilot plan & comms. I'll put acceptance criteria doc in the roadmap folder and link here: https://redwood.internal/optimize/alerts/pilot-draft (WIP). Sync Friday 10am. :calendar: :eyes:

Mike (eng): Quick question — for the quant fallback, do we want an automated switch or an advisory mode first? I'd vote for advisory + manual approve on first 2 tenants.

Tara (eng-ml): Advisory first. Turn on auto-switch only after 2 successful pilots and a regression validation run.

Alicia (product): Sounds good. Meeting invite sent. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
